scope: Focused actual-source correction controls prepared before candidate access

groups.name: EditorInfo exact-class admission order
groups.require: Main first; null/subclass refusal before native/live getter, attempt, revoke, creator or output; hostile setters/getters never called; initially healthy connection and caller output unchanged; exact framework object succeeds.

groups.name: Renderer-wide foreign new-entry exclusion
groups.require: Unfocused A action while B retains focused healthy connection; B adapter/query/creator/key/menu/second replacement refuse before native getter; false alone never retires/closes B; getHandler null exception; later B entry usable.

groups.name: SNAPSHOTTING before opaque payload evaluation
groups.require: Reserve before CharSequence length/charAt/subSequence/toString callback; own/foreign new entry excluded; invalid snapshot releases without revoke or native effect; no new queue/core slot; actual owned payload reaches super.

groups.name: Positive values and predecessor ordering
groups.require: Fresh/admitted with/without target; updated/same/empty invoke native setter and return true; own old close once on Eold before accessibility super; no absent-target fiction; Enew/native selection; old adapter stays revoked; later fresh connection works.

groups.name: Exact own-predecessor close exception
groups.require: editorCloseAllowed(record,attempt), replacementBegin/End and drain bind exact operation/Record/attempt/Eold; foreign/wrong tuple receives no close; native-depth, operation and commit barriers unchanged; deferred/uncertain alone not executing authority.

groups.name: Final tuple validation and captured close target
groups.require: Passive super.getEditableText; final scalar tuple/roster/target checks after getter; dispatch captured lease.target; bind prior roster-loss/foreign-target controls to actual passive getter hooks; reflection remains bounded invariant injection.

groups.name: Movement/setter/action callback order
groups.require: Final one-arg setter dispatches virtual two-arg setter once; first Enew can occur before watcher; exact identity through setter and later action selection; empty uses pinned default movement zero; unknown callback/second setter refuses.

groups.name: Owned mutable payload and Annotation
groups.require: Original Bundle/CharSequence mutation cannot alter approved native payload; Annotation key/value/range/flags preserved without requiring unselected object identity; invalid/null/UTF16/oversize/unsupported span refuses before revoke.

groups.name: Exactly one Eold to Enew promotion
groups.require: First observation only within selected setter; second new identity, Eold reversion or wrong field/record/roster fails; no old cleanup Mutation across transition; field-only continuation grants no bind/layout/foreign/adapter permission.

groups.name: One post-super event and no native suffix
groups.require: One synchronous textChange for changed/same/empty after final original authority/Enew/value/selection checks; capture string before clear; replacement busy false at normal feature dispatch; compatible Binding preserves state; after delivery scalar/completed-result only, no native getter/postcheck/second event.

groups.name: Clean false versus partial native execution
groups.require: False with no setter/change/current authority returns false/no event; true/no setter, partial mutation, native throw or late authority loss is uncertainty; no invented rollback/success.

groups.name: Foreign lifecycle continuation and loss persistence
groups.require: Actual lifecycle super/known suffix still runs during exclusion; loss records immediately/persists; no foreign own-predecessor close exception; later eligible cleanup once; gain never revives adapter; stale native facts do not clear denial.

groups.name: Owner/disposal/lifecycle reentry at native stages
groups.require: Close, accessibility super, setter, early callback, setter return, late selection, final check, feature event; busy through suffix/restoration/cleanup/reporting; direct disposal before session guarded; no synchronous owner resume after final cleanup clear; Handler rejection pending.

groups.name: replacementEnd failure/fatal/busy retention
groups.require: Final end wrong-tuple/invariant failure observed while exact reservation remains busy; original native first fatal still escapes over later ordinary/fatal end failure; unbalanced reservation retained, never fabricated cleared; no interface/core/coordinator authority added.

groups.name: Complete regression and pinned compilation
groups.require: All38 actual descriptors/offmain/stale/default tripwire; creator/EditorInfo/output/fatal/constructor/lifecycle/depth/serial/cleanup controls; ordinary IME Binding and temporary-seal state preservation; no native successful commit-finish; owner/core/observer unchanged, coordinator only original2guards; complete-source host plus pinned SDK/D8.

first_failure_policy: Preserve source/compile/control first failures; document mechanical API/hook adaptation without weakening expectations
changed_expectations: EditorInfo subclass tests now require pre-effect unchanged refusal
ACTION_SET_TEXT tests now require success including unfocused field
original sealed failure receipts remain immutable
